extra_state_attributes.forecast_description: This sensor shows a forecast all-in electricity tariff price in $/kWh, calculated by combining the calibrated AEMO PD7DAY 7-day pre-dispatch spot price forecast with the applicable network tariff time-of-use component for the Energex Small Business Demand tariff. Actual tariff costs will also depend on your specific retail contract, metering configuration, and any applicable controlled load, demand, or feed-in components not captured here.

extra_state_attributes.forecast_description: This sensor shows a forecast all-in electricity tariff price in $/kWh, calculated by combining the calibrated AEMO PD7DAY 7-day pre-dispatch spot price forecast with the applicable network tariff time-of-use component for the Ergon Mt Isa Small Business TOU Energy tariff. The spot component is the isotonic-calibrated AEMO forecast adjusted for distribution loss factor (DLF=1.05905), metering loss factor (MLF=1.0154), and market factors (combined multiplier=1.09192×), which increase the effective cost of spot energy at the meter relative to the wholesale price. The network component ($/kWh) varies by time of day per the tariff period structure above and is sourced from AER-approved distributor pricing. The final price includes a 10% GST component and an additional usage fee (currently 0.0293 $/kWh, configurable via the number entity 'nem_pd7day_qld1_additional_usage_fee') added before GST. IMPORTANT: This is a forecast only and should not be relied upon as an accurate prediction of actual electricity costs. Spot prices are inherently volatile and can differ significantly from forecasts, particularly beyond 24 hours. Actual tariff costs will also depend on your specific retail contract, metering configuration, and any applicable controlled load, demand, or feed-in components not captured here.
